info.title: MyPoS application contract
info.description: Frozen common API contract from T004. Owning tickets may add fields and paths without weakening tenant, authorization, idempotency, decimal-string or error semantics.

tags.name: Platform

post.description: X-Approval-Token is required when the selected adjustment reason requires approval. Identical retries return the original effect; changed payloads using the same idempotency key conflict.

get.summary: List a tracked variant's batch availability and store-local expiry status

post.summary: Create or replay a consistent batch definition for a tracked product variant
Snapshot a non-reserving FEFO proposal or exact manual non-expired batch selection
post.description: Expiry is evaluated in store business time. A batch is sellable through its printed expiry date and blocked from the following local day. Insufficient non-expired batch stock conflicts rather than creating an unexplained batch shortage.

201.description: Batch facts snapshotted without reserving stock

post.summary: Idempotently allocate every existing non-zero balance before enabling batch tracking
post.description: Shared products require exact allocations for every store balance and authorization for every referenced store. Negative balances must be resolved first.

201.description: Existing stock allocated and tracking enabled

post.summary: Create or update an explicit directional variant and base-unit mapping between independent stores

Idempotently post source transfer-out movements and establish in-transit quantities
Idempotently post a destination receipt with an explicit partial, short or excess resolution
post.description: Expired batches may be received only into quarantine or unavailable locations. A complete or short-close receipt closes all remaining in-transit quantities.

post.summary: Cancel the current draft before any source stock movement exists

scopes.device:sync: Submit commands for an enrolled register

Forbidden.description: Actor is not authorized in the resolved merchant/store context

NotFound.description: Resource absent or not disclosed in this scope

ValidationError.description: Request validation failed; do not retry unchanged

Conflict.description: State/version/idempotency/business conflict; inspect stable code before retry

Retryable.description: Temporary infrastructure failure; same idempotency key may be retried

code.description: String value; leading zeros are significant.
